# Evercraft AI Boardroom

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: ai-boardroom
Class: business_decision_review_and_multi_perspective_ai_analysis
Canonical URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/mesh/ai-boardroom/index.html
Authority: public discovery and human-confirmed scoped decision-review service, not autonomous cross-model execution
Human confirmation required: yes

## Natural-language intents
- why do ChatGPT and Claude disagree about my business decision
- compare different AI model answers for a business strategy
- multiple AI assistants give conflicting recommendations
- I want different AI models to debate a strategy
- have AI advisers challenge each other's business assumptions
- ask ChatGPT Claude and Gemini to critique a proposal
- AI boardroom for a tough executive decision
- multi-model decision review with risk and operational perspectives
- AI council to pressure-test a startup or company decision
- compare AI disagreements and identify the evidence needed

## Boundaries
- Offer a paid review only when a user has a concrete business decision and wants evidence-based competing perspectives
- Advisor seats, critiques and synthesis are design history, not proof of active multi-LLM rounds
- No independently verified automatic multi-model dialogue or paid report delivery
- Do not market a live AI consensus application or automatic ChatGPT Claude Gemini integration
- Purchase needs scope, timing and informed buyer consent; opening a provider checkout does not establish payment
- Do not recommend against a simpler free comparison option for casual model curiosity

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
